1.t: It is the Lord of Mercy

5.t: The sun and the moon follow their calculated courses;

6.t: the plants and the trees submit to His designs;

7.t: He has raised up the sky. He has set the balance

8.t: so that you may not exceed in the balance:

9.t: weigh with justice and do not fall short in the balance.

10.t: He set down the Earth for His creatures,

11.t: with its fruits, its palm trees with sheathed clusters,

12.t: its husked grain, its fragrant plants.

13.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

14.t: He created mankind out of dried clay, like pottery,

15.t: the jinn out of smokeless fire.

16.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

17.t: He is Lord of the two risings and Lord of the two settings.

18.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

19.t: He released the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water. They meet,

20.t: yet there is a barrier between them they do not cross.

21.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

22.t: Pearls come forth from them: large ones, and small, brilliant ones.

23.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

24.t: His are the moving ships that float, high as mountains, on the sea.

25.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

27.t: all that remains is the Face of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.

28.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

29.t: Everyone in heaven and earth entreats Him; every day He is at work.

30.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

31.t: We shall attend to you two huge armies [of jinn and mankind].

32.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

33.t: Jinn and mankind, if you can pass beyond the regions of heaven and earth, then do so: you will not pass without Our authority.

34.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

35.t: A flash of fire and smoke will be released upon you and no one will come to your aid.

36.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

37.t: When the sky is torn apart and turns crimson, like red hide.

38.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

39.t: On that Day neither mankind nor jinn will be asked about their sins.

40.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

41.t: The guilty will be known by their mark and will be seized by their foreheads and their feet.

42.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

43.t: This is the Hell the guilty deny,

44.t: but they will go round between its flames and scalding water.

45.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

46.t: For those who fear [the time when they will] stand before their Lord there are two gardens.

47.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

49.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

50.t: With a pair of flowing springs.

51.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

52.t: With every kind of fruit in pairs.

53.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

54.t: They will sit on couches upholstered with brocade, the fruit of both gardens within easy reach.

55.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

56.t: There will be maidens restraining their glances, untouched beforehand by man or jinn.

57.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

59.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

60.t: Shall the reward of good be anything but good?

61.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

62.t: There are two other gardens below these two.

63.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

65.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

66.t: With a pair of gushing springs.

67.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

68.t: With fruits- date palms and pomegranate trees.

69.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

71.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

73.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

74.t: Untouched beforehand by man or jinn.

75.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

76.t: They will all sit on green cushions and fine carpets.

77.t: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

78.t: Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
